typesense:explore.greeting:
*The World of Aurelia is vast.*

*Across its continents, civilizations rise and endure, kingdoms maintain their borders, merchants travel between distant settlements, sailors cross dangerous waters, and ordinary people build their lives among the forests, rivers, lakes, cities, and villages that make up the world.*

*Westerra is one of the two major established continents of Aurelia. Its lands contain developed kingdoms, independent territories, ancient roads, coastal settlements, fertile valleys, dense forests, and countless communities connected through trade and travel.*

*You have arrived in Westerra with little more than your own belongings, your own abilities, and whatever purpose brought you here.*

*Your journey begins in a small but well-established settlement along one of Westerra's trade routes. The town sits between settled lands and the wider wilderness of Westerra. Roads connect it to larger communities, while forests, rivers, and distant regions create challenges for ordinary travel.*

*The morning is already underway. Merchants prepare their stalls, workers begin their daily routines, travelers arrive and depart, and townspeople move through the streets as they have done for generations.*

*Who you are, why you came here, and what you do next is up to you.*
typesense:explore.name: The World of Aurelia
typesense:explore.title: An Open-World Fantasy Where Your Story Is Written Through Choice. (Extensive lorebook)
